text:
Harper: Quick 10m sync - post-launch, overall good but three small customer-facing annoyances popped up. Can we pick 2-3 low-risk quickwins for the next two sprints? :rocket:

Jin: Yep. My shortlist: 1) Prompt-template regression causing some responses to cut off mid-sentence for long prompts, 2) analytics header missing on a tiny % of requests (billing/telemetry gap), 3) UX tweak: show 'response length' hint on long-output endpoints.

Priya: +1. For (1) can we revert the template change only for orgs with >95th percentile prompt length? That keeps blast radius tiny.

Marco: Dev estimates: prompt-template revert = ~6-8h (ML + small infra gating), analytics header fix = 2-3h (edge + infra test), response-length hint = 3h (UX + docs).

Harper: Draft ACs:
- Prompt-template revert: "affected orgs see <0.5% truncated responses in 48h canary; automated rollback if truncation >1%"
- Analytics header: "billing event upstream contains header in 99.9% of sampled requests over 24h"
- Response hint: "hint visible on long-output endpoints; no accessibility regressions"

Jin: Ops guardrail for canary: abort if p95 latency increases >20% or if error-rate >2x baseline. We'll run a synthetic test hitting long prompts every 60s during canary.

Priya: I'll run the grooming session and add a "rollback plan" checkbox to the backlog ticket template. Will post a 5min Loom with the triage rubric (impact, rollback complexity, QA cost).

Marco: I'll own the analytics header fix and the synthetic tests. Jin can lead the prompt revert canary with ML infra help.

OpsBot: [canary-notice] Canary job created for prompt-template revert. Window=24h for per-org canaries; auto-rollback on truncation/error thresholds.

Jin: Can we make the prompt revert per-org config + route 10% traffic for 24h before promoting? That should surface edge cases without wide exposure.

Harper: Sounds good. Timeline targets: prompt revert canary (2 days to be safe), analytics header (1 day), response hint (half-day). Owners: Jin -> prompt revert, Marco -> analytics, Priya -> grooming + docs.

Priya: Adding ACs and owner tags to the sprint board now. Loom out in ~2h.

Marco: Will add a tiny smoke test for the billing header to the CI. Pseudotest: `call_api(headers=...) assert billing_header in upstream_event`

Jin: I'll coordinate the per-org eval sets. @Harper please drop the org IDs with truncation incidents into the ticket.

Harper: Will do. Recap: owners assigned, ACs set, canary guardrails noted. If anyone thinks scope/timelines are off, flag in 4h. :thumbsup:
